name: research-p5c
description: P5c: several retrieved domain candidates in RD mode competition. The historical path offers only the minimum-RMS fit to modes 2/3; group `candidates8` offers the eight best-RMS fits instead and charges the same search evaluations (top-k retention adds no fits) plus a little per-leaf mode pricing. Modes 0/2/3 only -- with modes 0/2 alone the wider list is provably inert here, since mode 2's rate is a handful of coordinate symbols while RMS dominates. Lambda grid matches the P5a objective audit (200/800/3200; lambda 50 still omitted for runtime). Kodak grayscale, fixed residual step 8. Three points are a diagnostic, not a BD-rate interval: four overlapping points per arm per image would be needed for that.
